parts.group: Booking reconciliation
parts.part: SPINE body as booked in geometry.yaml (design panels, zip, SH-01..04, roll-top HDPE) vs the cut-set body metric (333.2 g) that corrie.weight_table() subtracts

cuts.change: Ship belt B with an unprinted face until test HB-2 passes (DECISIONS 2026-11-09: grip face only after HB-2, not counted before). If HB-2 passes and the owner adopts it, the grams come back.
cuts.load_path: no: friction is not credited before HB-2 (belt-B structural uses no grip)

cuts.change: Wrap tail allowance 250 -> 150 mm (cut length = haul path + 150). The haul path, which sets the meat-mode girth, is unchanged.
cuts.load_path: touches the wrap, not its capacity: strap and box-X unchanged; ladder-lock needs a gloved tail, 150 mm is still a full hand (ASSUMPTION)

cuts.change: S-03 on CORRIE: drop grosgrain on the 7.28 m of bound body seams; second 301 row 6 mm into the allowance, trim, hot-knife sear. Gate: 3-cycle wash swatch (R-12), no fray past row 2.
cuts.durability: ULTRA 200 laminate edge may fray; rougher inside where game bags rub
cuts.load_path: no: no seam capacity counts the binding; HE/B-18 seam governed by the B-05 strip (SF 2.31, unchanged)

cuts.change: Delete the SH-03 camo band on the roll-top hem (hem stays body solid). Camo stays on the kick plates, wing bars, door garages and pouch top.
cuts.look: less camo at the top of the bag
cuts.load_path: no

cuts.change: Pouch base + boxing strip 330D Cordura -> 100D Robic (already in the BOM: collar, IMP-2, IMP-4). Top stays camo 630D.
cuts.durability: tear 90/80 -> 45/40 N warp/weft (records); the pouch rides on the roll and comes off, but gets set on rock
cuts.load_path: no

cuts.change: Pouch top camo 630D -> body-solid 330D; a camo pull tab marks it.
cuts.durability: lower abrasion on the top face (Taber 1000 -> 800)
cuts.look: the pouch top loses its camo panel
cuts.load_path: no

cuts.change: Pouch 320 x 210 x 70 -> 280 x 190 x 60 mm (4.0 -> 2.71 L). Loadout check: the snacks / GPS that miss on S-L ride in it, so it must still take 150 x 100 x 35 + a 160 mm GPS.
cuts.load_path: no

cuts.change: Sleeve panel IMP1-a 330D -> 100D Robic (XLPE + facing kept). The panel sits under the wing, facing it, not the brush.
cuts.durability: tear 90/80 -> 45/40 N (records) on a panel the scope slides against
cuts.load_path: no

cuts.change: Sew the phone pocket to the LEFT J-strap (bartacked through the strap binding) instead of 2 wrap straps + 2 G-hooks. Loses moving it to the right strap and taking it off.
cuts.load_path: no (the strap carries it, ~0.3 kg)

cuts.change: Gussets, U-surround, door, hinge band, wings 330D -> 210D UHMWPE grid (O-4). Still ON HOLD: the record has no abrasion value, and the owner has not seen a swatch.
cuts.durability: tear 90/80 -> 180/160 N (records, better); abrasion unknown (no record value)
cuts.look: visible grid on the solid colour
cuts.load_path: the wing roots and corner seams hold the wing-strap loops: tear goes up, so no SF falls; no seam check on file for the grid

cuts.change: Collar B-06 100D Robic -> 70D ripstop (O-3). Still ON HOLD: no 70D record (bag_weight_plan.MISSING, ASSUMPTION 70 gsm).
cuts.load_path: no (collar carries the roll, not the frame load)

cuts.change: Hypalon -> laser-cut TPU-coated 840D on the trims that carry no load: B-12 strap ports x6, IMP-2 hose-port frames x2, IMP-8 cam-cup base. One sheet material with O-15 if that is taken.
cuts.quiet: WORSE: quietness 4 -> 2 (records), stiff edge can tick on webbing
cuts.load_path: no: B-12 ports carry no load (build_simplicity S-02 note); hose ports and cam base are trims

cuts.change: Bow-tie 6061-T6 1.5 mm -> 7075-T6 1.2 mm (hipbelt_structural.md section 6.1). 7075-T6 cannot be cold-rolled: form in O temper and age (service) or machine the arc.
cuts.load_path: YES: plate today SF/req C2 1.21, walking fatigue 1.20 (6061); the structural note's model gives 1.77 (fatigue) at 1.2 mm 7075, not yet checked in the FE
cuts.rec: C: structural-fea-engineer re-run + forming quote ($25 ASSUMPTION heat-treat service)

cuts.change: PA66 hub bushing D36 x 12 -> D28 x 10 (section 6.2).
cuts.load_path: YES: hub-bore bearing, walking 1.66 with H on the pin, 5.3 without (the pad seat keeps H off)

cuts.change: Lightening holes in the bow-tie spine flanges, x 30-55 (section 6.3; -5 g is the structural note's estimate).
cuts.load_path: YES: the spine carries the C2 peak (SF/req 1.21 today)

cuts.change: HDPE pad backer 1.0 -> 0.8 mm (corrie_body.md 11.2: the backer bridges the 70 mm channel).
cuts.load_path: YES: the backer carries the lumbar push (413 N at 15 in, 1 g) across the 70 mm channel; NO SF on file
cuts.rec: C: structural-fea-engineer (plate bending over the channel) + HB-1 fit

cuts.change: Bottom B-05 500D -> Challenge ULTRA 200 (O-5): the records now carry the evidence (Taber 1500 -> 2000, tear 130 -> 250 N, waterproof floor). ULTRA is already 4 CORRIE pieces, and 500D then stays only on B-16 floor channels and the rifle boot.
cuts.look: stock ULTRA colour on the floor
cuts.load_path: YES: the HE / B-18 bag-on seam is governed by the B-05 fabric strip, 2355 N, SF 2.31 on 500D; ULTRA's grab strength is not in its record -> PT-3 strip test
cuts.rec: YES if PT-3 holds (evidence for the held O-5)

cuts.change: B-11 lash tabs Hypalon -> laser-cut TPU-coated 840D (O-15).
cuts.load_path: YES: 25 x 5 slot to the 450 N buckle class; no SF on file -> 5-sample slot pull test
cuts.rec: YES if the pull test holds (held O-15)

cuts.change: CFRP yoke plate 1.5 -> 1.2 mm (0.0182 m2, cfrp_plate_quasi_iso).
cuts.load_path: YES: the lifters and straps anchor here (T1(c), 102 kg on straps + lifters); NO SF on file (build_simplicity X-1 flag)

cuts.change: Stay rails 120 mm / 80 mm backer -> 130 mm / 70 mm backer (back_rail.md row r130_b70).
cuts.load_path: comfort: peak 13.89 kPa vs 13.76 today (limit 14, margin 1.008); air gutter 110 -> 100 mm and the rail edge moves onto the rib curve (x +/-180)
